projects.name: Breach Protocol
projects.desc: A hands-on hacking game. Play the attacker on a deliberately broken shop, find all five flaws every quick-built site ships with, and learn the one fix for each. Beginner mode walks you through it, and every technical word is hover-to-explain. Built at AI Sundays.

projects.name: Dealround
projects.tagline: Every Copenhagen deal on one map
projects.desc: An independent aggregator for Copenhagen. A Python scraper walks eight Danish deal sites and four event sources, strips the junk listings and the cross-site duplicates, translates the Danish titles into English, and puts what survives on one searchable map. Next.js frontend on Vercel, scraper on a Hetzner box.
